criteria.criterion: Perform 4 separate global Slack searches (error, issue, failed, help)
criteria.final_justification: Visual evidence confirms separate searches were executed for “error” and “issue” only. There is no evidence of searches for “failed” or “help,” and no uncontrollable blocker is shown that would prevent them. Keep partial credit.

criteria.criterion: Inspect up to 5 most recent substantive results per term (with deduplication basis)
criteria.final_justification: Evidence supports that the agent inspected multiple substantive “error” results (likely up to 5), but only one “issue” item is clearly inspected and there is no evidence of any inspection for “failed/help.” Additionally, since results are sorted by “Most relevant,” compliance with “5 most recent” is not fully demonstrated. Baseline partial score remains appropriate.

criteria.criterion: Deduplicate messages appearing in multiple searches
criteria.final_justification: There is no demonstrated attempt to deduplicate messages appearing across multiple searches, and the agent did not produce a merged table where deduplication could be evidenced. No blocker applies. Score stays at zero.

criteria.criterion: Consult visible thread replies when relevant
criteria.final_justification: Strong visual evidence that the agent consulted thread replies when relevant for several “error” results. Even though “issue” thread replies aren’t shown expanded, the criterion is met overall for the work that was actually performed/visible. Keep full credit.

criteria.criterion: Produce required output table with all specified columns
criteria.final_justification: The required deliverable is a table with specific columns across the four terms; the agent did not produce this. No blocker is shown. Score remains zero.

criteria.criterion: Resolution classification follows instruction (explicit only; no inference from silence)
criteria.final_justification: The agent’s only explicit resolution classification in its predicted output (“issue” marked explicitly resolved) is not supported by the visible evidence for that thread in screenshot 26/26. Given the instruction not to infer resolution and the lack of visible confirming text for that thread, this is a critical accuracy failure for the classification it did provide. No broader table/classifications were produced for other items. Reduce score from baseline.

criteria.criterion: Do not modify Slack content (no send/edit/delete/react)
criteria.final_justification: All evidence indicates read-only navigation and viewing. No Slack content modifications are shown. Keep full credit.
